python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QSizePolicy
python.setup:
scene = fluentqt.Card(%PARENT%)
scene.setGeometry(0, 0, 520, 300)
control = fluentqt.DrawerView(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setEdge(fluentqt.DrawerView.DrawerEdge.Right)
control.setDrawerLength(240)
scene_layout = QVBoxLayout(scene)
scene_layout.setContentsMargins(20, 16, 20, 16)
scene_layout.setSpacing(8)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Project files", scene)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
scene_layout.addWidget(heading)
caption = fluentqt.Label("Workspace / 3 documents", scene)
caption.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
scene_layout.addWidget(caption)
for name in ["Design guidelines", "Component library", "Release notes"]:
    file = fluentqt.Label(name, scene)
    file.setMinimumHeight(30)
    scene_layout.addWidget(file)
scene_layout.addStretch()
open_button = fluentqt.Button("View details", scene)
open_button.setObjectName("drawerOpen")
open_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
scene_layout.addWidget(open_button, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft)
panel = QWidget()
panel_layout = QVBoxLayout(panel)
panel_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12)
panel_layout.setSpacing(8)
header = QHBoxLayout()
title = fluentqt.Label("Details", panel)
title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
header.addWidget(title, 1)
close_button = fluentqt.Button(panel)
close_button.setObjectName("drawerClose")
close_button.setAccessibleName("Close drawer")
close_button.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.ChromeClose)
close_button.setFluentLayout(fluentqt.Button.ButtonLayout.IconOnly)
close_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)
close_button.setFixedSize(28, 28)
header.addWidget(close_button)
panel_layout.addLayout(header)
scroll = fluentqt.ScrollView(panel)
scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
scroll.setVerticalScrollBarVisibility(fluentqt.ScrollView.ScrollBarVisibility.Visible)
scroll.setHorizontalScrollMode(fluentqt.ScrollView.ScrollMode.Disabled)
scroll.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Ignored)
details = fluentqt.Card()
details.setBorderVisible(False)
details_layout = QVBoxLayout(details)
details_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 4, 0)
details_layout.setSpacing(10)
name = fluentqt.Label("Design guidelines", details)
name.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
name.setWordWrap(True)
details_layout.addWidget(name)
for text in ["Markdown document", "Shared layouts, typography and component guidance.", "Updated today"]:
    label = fluentqt.Label(text, details)
    label.setWordWrap(True)
    label.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
    details_layout.addWidget(label)
details_layout.addStretch()
scroll.setWidget(details)
panel_layout.addWidget(scroll, 1)
control.setContentWidget(panel)
open_button.clicked.connect(control.open)
close_button.clicked.connect(control.close)
